items.title: Apache NuttX Vulnerability Let Attackers to Crash Systems
items.description: A newly disclosed use-after-free vulnerability in Apache NuttX RTOS could allow attackers to cause system crashes and unintended filesystem operations, prompting urgent security warnings for users running network-exposed services. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2025-48769 and rated moderate in severity, affects a wide range of NuttX versions and was publicly disclosed on December 31, 2025. The […] The…
